verdict.rationale: The evidence shows per-transaction fraud decisions and recommendations returned through the API: approve or decline decisions, CVV/3DS and TRA/SCA exemption recommendations, and approve/review/decline recommendations on claims. These are outputs of the core decisioning service, not AI-generated insights or suggestions about the merchant's own data surfaced inside the product. No in-product analytics assistant, insight feed or dashboard of AI suggestions is documented, so the support is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
